subject: CAIQ deep-dive + telemetry sample exchange
messages:
From: Adam Keller <adam.keller@nimbusresearch.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nimsoft Security Team <security@nimsoft.com>
Date: 2026-08-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ scope & sample logs — quick sync

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this on. We reviewed Redwood's intake page and want to confirm a couple of things before the call tomorrow:

- Primary ask: CAIQ sections we care most about are Network Security, Logging & Monitoring, and Data Protection.
- For telemetry, we need a 24-hour and a 30-day snapshot for a few endpoints (auth, inference, and admin API). Can you confirm what the smallest useful log subset you can provide is?
- Would prefer the sample transfer via a secure Drive link or SFTP.

Can we do a short 30–45 minute deep-dive at 10:30am PT? If that works, I'll send calendar invites and our pen-test lead (Dave) will join.

Thanks,
Adam
Adam Keller
Head of Security Programs — Nimbus Research
adam.keller@nimbusresearch.com
[Attachment: initial-scope.pdf (application/pdf, 120KB)]

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Adam Keller <adam.keller@nimbusresearch.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-13T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ scope & sample logs — quick sync

Adam — thanks, 10:30am PT works for me. Looping in Marissa (compliance lead) and Ben (SRE) so we have the right owners on the call.

Quick answers up front so you have context:
- We can prioritize CAIQ sections you listed and will bring a section-to-artifact mapping that shows where evidence lives.
- Minimal log subset: for auth/inference/admin we can provide header-level metadata (timestamp, request_id, endpoint, status_code, user_id/pseudonymized_id) and a 1-hour full payload sample for each endpoint. For 24-hour/30-day, we can provide aggregated counts plus a redacted example event per day.
- Transfer options: secure Drive share (preferred by customers) or SFTP. We'll send the Drive link after the call and use pre-signed URLs for larger archives.

Agenda proposal for the call (30–45 mins):
1) CAIQ focus areas & success criteria (5m)
2) Evidence mapping walkthrough (10m)
3) Log sample format and retention/aggregation plan (15m)
4) Next steps: artifacts, owners, and delivery timeline (5–10m)

Attaching a short "section map" spreadsheet so you can flag anything missing before we meet.

See you at 10:30.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
[jasmine_liu@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: caiq-section-map.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 24KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-13T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Internal prep: Nimbus CAIQ call at 10:30am PT — quick notes

Team — a few prep notes for today's call with Nimbus:

- Ben: have the sample extraction plan ready (exact schema for pseudonymization, how we redact PII). Bring one redaction example.
- I'll own the CAIQ section mapping explanations and point to SOC 2 controls where applicable.
- Jasmine: confirm we can commit to sending Drive links within 48 hours post-call for the small artifacts (policy docs, controls evidence). For log archives (30-day), we'll note the need for an SFTP window.

Also, if Adam asks about retention snapshots, reference our retention matrix (we usually preserve raw telemetry 30 days on hot storage, up to 1 year cold). If they push for raw 1-year exports, flag as escalation to legal — we'll likely need a DPA amendment.

I'll be on the call and will take notes.

Marissa
Senior Compliance Manager — Redwood Inference

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Adam Keller <adam.keller@nimbusresearch.com>, Nimsoft Security Team <security@nimsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-14T15:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: CAIQ deep-dive + telemetry sample exchange

Adam — thanks again for today's discussion. Notes and agreed actions below. Forwarding the initial artifacts now.

--- Meeting notes (summary) ---
Attendees: Adam K., Dave (Nimbus pen-test), Jasmine L., Marissa C., Ben C.
Duration: 35 minutes

Key outcomes:
- Scope confirmed: CAIQ sections A.1 (Network), L.2 (Logging), D.3 (Data Protection) prioritized.
- Log samples: Redwood to deliver:
  * 1-hour full payload samples for auth/inference/admin endpoints (redacted)
  * Aggregated daily counts for 30 days (CSV)
  * Retention explanation: 30 days hot, 12 months cold; exports beyond 30 days require legal review
- Transfer method: secure Drive link for small artifacts; SFTP for >500MB archives.
- Owners & deadlines:
  * Jasmine: upload policy docs + section map to Drive by EOD 2026-08-15
  * Ben: generate mock log samples and manifest file by 2026-08-16
  * Marissa: draft short control mapping notes and send to Nimbus by 2026-08-17

Attachments sent: caiq-section-map.xlsx, log-sample-manifest.txt (manifest lists files and pseudonymization approach).

Next steps: Nimbus will validate the sample formats and flag any follow-ups. If they request longer retention exports, we'll open legal ticket.
